# commands
$ acerctl mode quiet
acerctl: not supported: thermal profiles is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl mode performance
acerctl: not supported: thermal profiles is not available on this hardware (performance is Acer's Turbo; Acer's Performance mode is balanced-performance)
[exit 1]
$ acerctl fan all max
acerctl: not supported: fan control is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl fan cpu 40
acerctl: not supported: fan control is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl fan all auto
acerctl: not supported: fan control is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl kbd timeout 0
[exit 0]
$ acerctl usb-charging 20
acerctl: not supported: USB charging is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl battery limit off
[exit 0]
$ acerctl battery limit on
[exit 0]
$ acerctl battery calibrate start
[exit 0]
